purpose: Predeclare a bounded rainfall-closure follow-up before the common-mass pilot completes: keep the middle humidity ratio .2 fixed and test higher column humidity thresholds to delay premature rainout. This is a new physical family, not extra humidity candidates after that pilot.
physical_definition: Keep common-mass two-branch transport, lower mass fraction .25, fixed1km lower shear and upper/lower specific-humidity ratio .2. Only generic rain-activation rh_threshold changes from adopted .3677449 to fixed .5/.6/.7. No tau, rain multiplier, regional mask, Earth planetary or boundary forcing adjustment. The model column RH uses approximate saturated-column capacity, so these are plausible sensitivity values, not measured cloud-base relative humidities. Test whether delaying rainout improves delivery/placement; evaluate actual coupled solves, not offline rescaled rain.
control: Seven unchanged r39 climates/geography and3 native winds must reproduce exactly. Seven new transport-control climates must reproduce every archived mass-tracer020 NPZ field, then21 candidate solves. Same .05/1024 work except original reference; all original error tolerances, branch/mass/operator certificates and seven-region protections preserved. Preserve numerical failures.
screen: All strict numerical/conservative-vapor/storm checks and scaled column-mass residual<=1e-10 required. Same accuracy guards: S<=.995, mean rain ratio<=.99,T ratio<=1.01; NI rain ratio<=.95; Iran<=1.02; every other region S<=1.02. Actual integrated SST MAE increase<=.02C on identical observation-only masks, column speed max<=60m/s,p95<=25m/s. Fixed outside-wind guards: NI native partial-column vector RMSE improvement>=5%; Iberia ocean/EastAustralia lowland worsening<=2%, identical masks and areas. No additional candidate, weakened threshold or new validation sampling after outcomes. Also require two_layer_transport certificate with dry-column residual<=1e-10 and EACH branch wind maximum<=60m/s,p95<=25m/s (all primer/scored steps), rather than hiding a fast return in the weighted mean. Exactly3 fixed humidity ratios; no extra candidates after outcomes.
advance: Best at most2 fixed qualifiers advance through unchanged full31 policy_v2 and individual regional protections, integrated ocean/wind checks, paired28km four-region S<=1.01 plus NI rain ratio<=.98, and established6 S<=1.01 once. Record physical/numerical blocks separately. These are reused development sets, not new independent validation. Independent branch mass/speed and mass-tracer certificates are now checked in every full31/ocean/fine/established gate, not just the seven-region pilot.
publication: This plan is declared before the parent common-mass pilot completes and before any new threshold scores. Exactly3 humidity thresholds, fixed middle transport ratio .2; no added threshold/ratio candidates after outcomes. No climate/atlas adoption unless unchanged full31/ocean/fine/established6 and matched-world gates all pass. No city/global-score claim from these reused regions.
